Specification: A specification of a distributed spanning-tree algorithm. Each non-root process learns its parent by receiving messages from neighbors; messages travel over an asynchronous channel modeled by a set of pairs. The spec asserts type-correctness, eventual termination of all processes (every node either is the root or has chosen a parent in the neighbor graph), the OneParent stability property, and the SntMsg invariant that no orphan node has sent any message.
IfThenElse: IF i # root /\ prnt[i] = NoPrnt /\ <<j, i>> \in msg THEN Update(i, j) ELSE \/ Send(i) \/ Parent(i) \/ UNCHANGED <<prnt, msg, rpt>>
TemporalSubscript: WF_vars(\E i, j \in Proc: IF i # root /\ prnt[i] = NoPrnt /\ <<j, i>> \in msg THEN Update(i, j) ELSE \/ Send(i) \/ Parent(i) \/ UNCHANGED <<prnt, msg, rpt>>)
[][\A i \in Proc : prnt[i] # NoPrnt => prnt[i] = prnt'[i]]_vars
AlwaysOp: [][\A i \in Proc : prnt[i] # NoPrnt => prnt[i] = prnt'[i]]_vars
EventuallyOp: <>(\A i \in Proc : i = root \/ (prnt[i] # NoPrnt /\ <<i, prnt[i]>> \in nbrs))
FairnessConditions: WF_vars(\E i, j \in Proc: IF i # root /\ prnt[i] = NoPrnt /\ <<j, i>> \in msg THEN Update(i, j) ELSE \/ Send(i) \/ Parent(i) \/ UNCHANGED <<prnt, msg, rpt>>)
DivisionNotes: TemporalNesting is false; the spec uses only the standard [][Next]_vars and a top-level <>(...) Termination plus a [][...]_vars OneParent stability formula, none of which nest temporal operators inside others.

Action operators Update, Send, Parent, and Next contain primed variables and are listed in ActionDefNames; they are excluded from the partition categories of OperatorDefNames since the partition uses ActionDefNames as a separate fifth bucket per the schema.
CanSend is a state predicate over current-state variables; SntMsg and TypeOK assert state-level invariants; vars is a structural tuple value, placed in ValueDef.
